extDescription.message: Shows the IP address of the server behind the current website in the bottom-right corner. Hover to move it, click to copy.

optDnsFallback.message: If the connection IP is unknown, resolve the host via DNS (dns.google)

optHint.message: Hover the badge to move it to the other corner. Click copies the IP. Double click hides it until the page is reloaded.

badgeTitleConnection.message: IP of the server that delivered $HOST$

badgeTitleCached.message: IP of the server that last delivered $HOST$ (this load came from the HTTP cache)

badgeTitleDns.message: DNS answer for $HOST$ (the connection IP was not available)

badgeTitleUnknown.message: IP for $HOST$ not available (page restored from cache; enable the DNS fallback in the options)

badgeHint.message: Click: copy. Double click: hide. Hover: move.
